name: luci-theme-footstrap-tooling
description: Lint/a11y tooling only. NOTHING here is shipped: the OpenWrt package is built by luci.mk, which copies htdocs/ and ucode/ verbatim and never invokes node. These devDependencies exist for CI and for local checks.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run check:mid && npm run check:slow
scripts.live: npm run upstream && npm run spa-parity && npm run live-audit && npm run scroll && npm run table-tick && npm run floor && npm run quiet && npm run anchor
scripts.check:fast: npm run lint && npm run shell && npm run marker && npm run audit && npm run conffiles && npm run acl && npm run i18n-packages && npm run makefile-contract && npm run test && npm run css-orphans && npm run css-i18n && npm run mirror && npm run bang-ok && npm run axes && npm run page-modules && npm run chrome-fence && npm run changelog
scripts.check:mid: npm run css-metrics && npm run css-floor && npm run css-dup && npm run size && npm run i18n
scripts.check:slow: npm run tables && npm run export-tier && npm run icons && npm run a11y && npm run smoke
